Team —

I've reviewed BrightKey's annotated MSA and the order form. High-level legal positions to carry into the kickoff:

Priority items to address now:
1) Indemnity / liability cap — BrightKey seeks broad indemnity for PHI exposure. We should offer a limited indemnity tied to our breach of platform security and capped at 1x ARR or a fixed dollar cap.
2) Data residency & processing — confirm whether our hosted deployment for this customer can guarantee US-only data processing. If not, propose contractual mitigations (e.g., contractual DPA + encryption at-rest/in-transit + sub-processor commitments).
3) SLA & credits — counter to a 99.9% baseline for pilots; offer 99.9% with a standard credit schedule.
4) Audit evidence — provide SOC 2 report and a redacted sub-processor list. BrightKey's request for continuous audit access is broad; propose periodic evidence reviews instead.

Additional asks: clarify retention and deletion timelines for PHI; push back on any language that requires us to host within BrightKey's VPC or to change fundamental deployment architecture.

Please see my inline questions (questions_for_brightkey.txt) — these are the items I recommend we surface at kickoff and ask BrightKey to confirm before legal executes redlines.

Timing: I can join the kickoff call Tue 5/3 between 09:00-11:00 PT. If we can't get SOC 2 before the call, let's at least get a copy of the latest report and a sub-processor list.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
